name: Telekinetic Lance
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect one lance of telekinetic force
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to affect the target with the telekinetic lance. If the attack hits, you deal 1d6 damage per level (maximum 10d6). The damage is considered magical piercing damage. Additionally, the target must make a Fortitude save or be launched back 5 feet per 4 caster levels you possess. After striking or missing its target, the telekinetic lance disappears.
